C0032.title: Ningbo, Zhejiang: Illegal Flash Sale Software Used to Snatch Limited Goods for Profit
C0032.summary: Media reports in June 2024 described a Ningbo police investigation into illegal flash-sale snatching. Police arrested Sheng and Zheng, seized order-snatching software and source code, and recovered more than 200 bottles of premium liquor. The suspects used algorithm cracking and AI programming to execute second-level purchases of limited goods in e-commerce livestream rooms, with the amount involved around 10 million yuan.
